app: Briefcase: private AI for law firms, working on the firm's own documents (built on AnythingLLM)

personas.cares_about: Profitability per lawyer, client confidentiality, malpractice and ethics risk.
personas.time_spent: Client work, business development, supervising associates, firm admin.
personas.struggles: Lawyers quietly using public ChatGPT on client files; can't see whether AI saves time or creates risk.
personas.how_helps: Firm insights show hours saved and what they are worth for a chosen period, who uses it, policy and training, client consent per matter, a supervision queue and an exportable audit log.

tasks.name: Matter switch rebinds answer, matter card and a viewer-true access line
expect: .right [data-testid='access-line']:has-text('You are not on the matter team (3 people)')

tasks.name: Money view with correct net return
Period selector recomputes the figures
Filter the audit log and see unapproved exports
expect: [data-testid='audit-log']:has-text('Asked for account balances at date of death')

personas.cares_about: Accurate work product fast; billable hours; never citing something that doesn't exist.
personas.time_spent: Reading discovery, deposition transcripts and prior briefs; drafting motions.
personas.struggles: AI tools that hallucinate and can't see the firm's own matter documents.
personas.how_helps: Ask the matter: citations numbered 1, 2, 3 per answer with Bates numbers; conflicting evidence and 'not found' are shown instead of a guess; each answer is stamped with the scope it searched.

tasks.name: Ask Reyes: per-answer numbering, conflict note, not-found guard
Switching to Estate of D. Liu: new answer, citations from 1, count matches
Search opens a real results panel
Associates cannot open Admin; matter tabs hidden outside matters
Citation opens the exact page with Bates number

personas.cares_about: Deadlines, organized files, chronologies the attorneys trust.
personas.time_spent: Building chronologies, indexing documents, calendaring deadlines.
personas.struggles: Chronologies take days and every entry must point to a document.
personas.how_helps: Timeline per matter with key dates (SOL with rule and a clear verified mark), deadlines with paragraph pin cites, filters, per-matter exports, and each event's source page.

tasks.name: Reyes timeline with key dates and verified deadline
Filter to testimony and export
Export banner does not follow to another matter
Bell badge equals the deadlines listed this week; holiday shown
Clicking an event shows its source

personas.cares_about: Booking good cases quickly and avoiding conflicts.
personas.time_spent: Calls, intake forms, conflict checks, scheduling consults.
personas.struggles: Conflict checks across old matters are slow and manual.
personas.how_helps: Intake queue with AI call summaries adapted to the case type, SOL with state and rule for attorney check, a conflict search that an attorney must clear, and consult booking that stays locked until clearance.

tasks.name: Summary, SOL with rule, conflict pending attorney
Booking is locked until the conflict is cleared
expect: [data-testid='booking']:has-text('Booking unlocks when the conflict is cleared')

tasks.name: Landlord-tenant caller: adapted fields and decline

personas.cares_about: Captured time, realization rate, clean invoices.
personas.time_spent: Chasing lawyers for time entries, prebills, collections.
personas.struggles: Lawyers forget to record time; AI-assisted work is hard to describe on a bill.
personas.how_helps: Time prepares entries from measured lawyer time; billing requests attorney approval and posts approved entries; contingency and flat-fee time bills $0; WIP and realization by matter.

tasks.name: Lands on Time; prebill rows with codes and $0 contingency
expect: text=Bill actual time only (ABA Formal Op. 512)

tasks.name: Billing requests approval; cannot approve
Post an attorney-approved entry
WIP and realization in the right bar

personas.cares_about: Security, integrations with the DMS and practice-management tools, vendor risk.
personas.time_spent: Vendor reviews, user access, keeping Clio/NetDocuments running.
personas.struggles: Vendors that can't say where data goes or which model sees it.
personas.how_helps: Admin states the data flow, names the model and region, lists subprocessors including the vendor and its support access model, security settings, an integration connect flow, and one access matrix.

tasks.name: Data flow, model, vendor access, security settings
Connect iManage with a real flow
Start the test sync
Admin locked when viewing as associate

personas.role: Immigration partner running a high-volume Spanish-language practice inside the firm
personas.cares_about: Volume of cases handled well; clients who understand their status.
personas.struggles: Translating and re-explaining letters to clients takes hours each week.
personas.how_helps: Draft from the matter's templates with cited facts and benchmark (not promised) timing, side-by-side Spanish, review gates before sending on the client's preferred channel, and batch letters for clients not yet written to.

tasks.name: Draft is bound to Herrera, uses benchmark wording, needs review
Side-by-side Spanish, unreviewed
Approve, review translation, send by WhatsApp
Batch excludes the client just written to
Reyes letter shows Reyes' own channel preference

personas.role: Solo in-house counsel at a 300-person company (separate customer)
personas.cares_about: Contract turnaround for sales; consistent positions.
personas.time_spent: Reviewing NDAs, MSAs and vendor contracts against the playbook.
personas.struggles: Same redlines every week; the playbook lives in her head.
personas.how_helps: Northwind workspace: contract requests with requester, business owner, counterparty and an SLA that skips holidays; review with section quotes, fallbacks and approvers; decisions saved back into the playbook.

tasks.name: Separate customer workspace with in-house request fields
Accept a row updates the redline button
Capture a decision in the playbook
NDA request with its own SLA
Loading state while a contract is indexing

personas.role: Firm administrator / office manager (often the actual buyer at 5-30 lawyer firms)
personas.cares_about: Overhead per lawyer, vendor cost vs value, staff productivity, smooth onboarding.
personas.time_spent: Vendor contracts, HR, onboarding staff, managing software subscriptions and IT providers.
personas.struggles: Can't compare AI vendors on cost and risk; seats bought and not used.
personas.how_helps: Plan and cost first: seats bought and active, monthly cost, cost per active user and per hour saved, seat optimisation, contract and renewal dates, invoices and the security pack.

tasks.name: Lands on plan and cost first
Download invoice and security pack
Invite users who are not onboarded; net return correct

personas.role: Firm general counsel / ethics or risk partner
personas.cares_about: Malpractice exposure, compliance with ABA Op. 512 and state bar guidance, insurer questionnaires.
personas.time_spent: Conflicts clearance, policy writing, answering malpractice carrier and client outside-counsel-guideline questionnaires.
personas.struggles: Clients' outside counsel guidelines restrict or require disclosure of AI; no record of which matters used AI.
personas.how_helps: AI-use register; restricted matters are never indexed and pending-consent matters are paused; ABA 512 plus New Jersey guidance; carrier questionnaire export.

tasks.name: Register filtered to client-restricted matters and exported
Carrier questionnaire answers
Meridian is not indexed for AI; access reason shown
Pending-consent matter is paused, not 'internal research'

personas.time_spent: Reading court orders and notices, entering and checking deadlines across all matters.
personas.struggles: Orders arrive by email/e-filing and must be read and calculated by hand; double entry with the calendar system.
personas.how_helps: Cross-matter queue of extracted and hand-entered deadlines with rule, source page, origin, derived deadlines and one holiday calendar; verify, correct, reject or post.

tasks.name: Queue with origin, derived deadline and holiday calendar
Verify, then post to the calendar
Correct a date with a reason
Reject an extraction

personas.cares_about: Quality and currency of templates, precedents and playbooks the AI draws on.
personas.time_spent: Curating the brief bank and templates, retiring outdated forms, training lawyers.
personas.struggles: AI may reuse outdated templates or superseded briefs; no way to mark the authoritative version.
personas.how_helps: Templates with status, last and next review, superseded-by and blocked use in Draft; brief bank with authority checks; retire with who, when and undo.

tasks.name: Lands on Knowledge with currency fields
Retire with who and when, and undo
See which drafts used it

personas.cares_about: Getting letters, filings and client updates out on time and correctly formatted.
personas.struggles: Re-typing facts from the file into letters; firm style formatting.
personas.how_helps: Drafts in firm style with facts filled and cited 1, 2, 3, sent to a chosen reviewer, exported on letterhead as DRAFT until approved.

tasks.name: Client update letter for Reyes with sequential cites
Choose a partner as reviewer, then export on letterhead
Cannot send to the client before approval

personas.cares_about: Accurate asset inventories, deadlines in probate, client communication with families.
personas.time_spent: Reviewing financial statements, wills, trusts; preparing inventories and court filings.
personas.struggles: Pulling assets and beneficiaries out of hundreds of statements.
personas.how_helps: Ask the estate's documents for an asset and beneficiary list with citations numbered from 1; export a cited inventory; tax deadlines that depend on beneficiary class.

tasks.name: Select Estate of D. Liu and get the cited inventory
Export the cited inventory
Inheritance tax depends on beneficiary class

personas.cares_about: Defensible review, privilege protection, production deadlines.
personas.time_spent: Loading productions, running searches, privilege logs.
personas.struggles: Large productions; privileged documents leaking into answers or drafts.
personas.how_helps: Production log with producing party, dates and a Bates gap check; privileged folder excluded by default; indexing progress with exceptions; answers stamped with their scope and re-runnable.

tasks.name: Production log, Bates check and privileged excluded by default
Load a new volume: indexing with progress
Old answer is flagged and re-run on the new scope
Sources list Bates numbers

personas.role: Conflicts analyst or new-business attorney who clears conflicts
personas.cares_about: No missed conflicts, fast clearance so intake can book, defensible records for lateral hires and new matters.
personas.time_spent: Reviewing near matches, contacting responsible partners for waivers, running lateral-hire conflict checks.
personas.struggles: Fuzzy matches across corporate families and former clients; clearance decisions are buried in email.
personas.how_helps: A clearance queue with each near match, the related-party tree, a recorded decision per match and a clearance that unlocks booking and matter opening.

tasks.name: Open the clearance queue with related parties
Decide each near match and clear
Conflicts role has no matter documents

personas.role: Records manager (the firm administrator also runs records at this size)
personas.cares_about: Retention schedules, legal holds, file closing and certified destruction, including AI indexes and chat logs.
personas.time_spent: Closing matters, applying holds, responding to client file-return requests.
personas.struggles: AI tools keep copies (embeddings, chat history) outside the retention schedule.
personas.how_helps: Per-matter retention and hold status that covers the Briefcase index and threads, with purge certificates.

tasks.name: Lands on Records with AI index coverage
Close Harbor Health: retention applied to index and threads
Legal hold on Reyes blocks purge

personas.role: Solo general practitioner (1 lawyer + 1 assistant), separate customer
personas.cares_about: Price per seat, setup without IT, fewer hours on routine letters.
personas.time_spent: Everything: intake, drafting, billing, client calls.
personas.struggles: No IT person to vet security; cannot justify enterprise pricing.
personas.how_helps: A one-seat plan, guided setup with Clio, and a self-review checklist that records supervision when no other lawyer exists.

tasks.name: Own tenant, one-seat plan and guided setup
Connect Clio
Approve own draft with the self-review checklist

personas.role: Training and professional-development manager (the KM attorney runs training at this size)
personas.cares_about: Competence under ABA 512 (Comment 8 to Rule 1.1), CLE credit, onboarding new hires.
personas.time_spent: Running trainings, tracking completion, onboarding laterals.
personas.struggles: Cannot show who is trained on AI, or what bad usage patterns look like.
personas.how_helps: Training completion by person, blocked-answer patterns as teaching material, module assignment and an exportable completion report.

tasks.name: Find the 2 active users without training
Assign the module and export the report
Training numbers agree with Firm insights
